cpu_allocation: Measured family CPU through pool collection is divided equally between the two seed receipts; individual task CPU is retained. Earlier-attempt CPU remains in its original receipts and is subtracted from this attempt's budget. Final receipt serialization is outside that timing window.

decision.pass_bar: Every one of the nine words must have at least 99 percent of null samples strictly above the real moment, p<=0.01, BH q<=0.05, and the held merge calibration must be within 1 percent. The second seed must reproduce the conjunction; otherwise protocol-specific NULL.
decision.scope: The statistic is a function of the paid profile, so N2 profile-preserving samples leave it unchanged. Even PASS fails the non-circular pattern criterion.

null_summary.detail: Per-word/control summaries and registered q-values are retained inside tasks.
null_summary.model: uniform ordered positive helper compositions at fixed width/part count; nine-word BH family

scope: Finite scoped evaluation; potential kappa levers are census targets only.
